sections.content: These four nouns name activities you can already talk about with a matching verb: sport pairs with sportolok (I do sports), pihenés with pihenek (I rest), tanulás with tanulok (I study), and munka with dolgozom (I work).
Three of these four follow the pattern you'd expect (-ok/-ek). The fourth, dolgozom, doesn't — and the next section explains exactly why.
